title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11816__PART_3_)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard gives guidance on the means of controlling attack by pests on cereals and pulses in storage. 1.2 Other aspects of storage of cereals and pulses are dealt with in Part 1 and 2 of this standard.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Methods of analysis for detection of insect and rodent contamination in grains and milled products

electrical_and_safety_parameters: temperature rises to an unfavorable level, usually not above 42°C
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
